items.title: 當威脅情報只剩大量數據，企業該相信什麼？
items.summary: 生成式AI降低了偵察、釣魚郵件撰寫及部分程式開發工作的門檻，使攻擊者得以更快、更大量地展開行動，企業導入模型、資料集、套件與AI工具後，擴大了軟體及AI供應鏈的風險。 這兩股力量交織之下，企業面對的不再是單一威脅，而是速度與範圍同時擴張的攻擊環境。卡巴斯基臺灣技術總監謝長軒指出，AI能大量產出資料，決定防禦成敗的關鍵，不是誰握有最多預警訊號，而是誰能把海量資料轉化為可以立即行動的情報。 他認為，好的威脅情報必須同時具備來源可信、時間有效、脈絡相關、信心度清楚與可執行等條件，AI能加快前段處理，專家則負責高風險判斷與情境分析，兩者缺一不可。

items.title: 日本IDC Frontier雲端遭勒索軟體攻擊，波及495家客戶、部分系統靠備份重建
items.summary: 日本雲端服務業者IDC Frontier旗下IDCF Cloud於10月7日遭勒索軟體攻擊，造成部分虛擬伺服器停機且無法重新啟動，影響495個企業及地方政府客戶。IDC Frontier在8日指出，受影響服務區的客戶資料恐難以取出或復原，目前研判只能透過客戶自行保存的備份重建系統。

items.title: 微軟測試新Windows Search，不只能搜尋還能執行動作
items.summary: 本周在Windows and Surface大會上，微軟宣佈為Windows Search改版，包括改用新的WinUI 3介面、更快速搜尋，並讓使用者透過Windows Search直接操作電腦設定。預計明年將整合Windows Search和Copilot。

items.title: HPE預告將推出第13代伺服器平臺，主打三大系統安全性強化特色
items.summary: 處理器大廠AMD今年7月底發表代號為Venice的第六代EPYC處理器，將於11月正式推出首批產品（EPYC 9006 SP7系列），部分伺服器廠商近期也陸續發表搭配這批處理器的新一代機型。

items.title: 3個國碼頂級網域遭劫持，攻擊者取得Google等組織HTTPS憑證
items.summary: Google近日揭露，該公司得知一連串網域劫持事件，攻擊者入侵迦納.gh、獅子山.sl及美屬薩摩亞.as等3個由第三方管理的國碼頂級網域名稱（country code top-level domain，ccTLD），竄改部分網域的權威DNS紀錄，並取得數個Google及其他組織網域的未經授權HTTPS憑證。Google指出，該公司本身的系統並未遭到入侵。

items.title: fix(gateway): Gateway stalls after startup recapturing plugins for mo…
items.summary: fix(gateway): Gateway stalls after startup recapturing plugins for model catalog updates (#167544) Related: #160959 ## What Problem This Solves Fixes: shortly after every Gateway start, the scheduled remote model catalog refresh copies every external plugin a second time and loads it cold. With a large plugin, this blocks the Gateway for as long as the startup capture did. ## User Impact User impact: when the hosted model catalog is newer than the installed build (the normal case for released versions), adopting it no longer re-copies or re-evaluates external plugins. The Gateway stays responsive after startup. Prepared turns keep using the Gateway's unchanged plugin instances, as they already do after config hot reloads. ## Why This Change Was Made #161267 made prepared model runtimes borrow unchanged plugin instances from the admitting Gateway. The lender is resolved from the Gateway registry scope of the work that triggers the rebuild. Hot reloads already run their prepared-runtime refresh inside that scope (`server-reload-hot.ts`). The post-ready `update.remote-model-catalog` scheduler job calls `applyRemoteModelCatalogUpdate` with no registry scope. The prepared rebuild therefore finds no lender, and its inbound registry cold-loads every plugin. This change runs scheduled catalog adoption inside the live Gateway registry scope, the same way the hot-reload refresh does. No new cache, manager or module sharing is added. Each registry keeps its own load and dispose lifecycle, and borrowing follows the existing #161267 contract. ## Evidence **Trigger proven on origin/main 6070074.** Runs were isolated Gateways with an external plugin used as the context engine, each held 60 s after `ready`, with scratch probes outside the repo: - Catalog refresh enabled: 8/8 runs captured and loaded the plugin a second time after ready. The probe at `loadPreparedInboundPluginRegistry` logged `lender=false requestScope=false` during `applyRemoteModelCatalogUpdate`, followed by `remote model catalog applied`. - Catalog refresh disabled (`models.catalogRefresh.enabled: false`): 3/3 runs had no second load. - Full stack of the second capture: `buildSnapshotBatch → prepareWorkspacePluginRegistries → loadPreparedInboundPluginRegistry → loadAgentRuntimePluginRegistryHandle → loadOpenClawPlugins`. - Cost on main with an 8k-file plugin: `startup.maintenance.plugin-registry` took 46.2 s and 57.7 s with event-loop max 45.2 s and 57.3 s, plus a 78 s post-ready reload in another run. **With this change.** Same harness: - On 6070074 with this patch: 7/7 runs had 0 loads after ready. In each run the catalog was refreshed (`status: updated`) and applied, and the probe logged `inbound lender=true requestScope=true`. - On this PR's exact head versus its exact parent: these builds are newer than the current hosted catalog, so the runs serve the same hosted catalog with a newer `generatedAt` from a loopback `models.catalogRefresh.url`. Each run was held 60 s after ready, and the catalog was refreshed (`status: updated`) and applied in every run. The parent loaded the plugin a second time after ready in 5/5 runs; this head did so in 0/7 runs. **Lifecycle:** on 6070074 with this patch, the catalog was adopted (borrowing the Gateway instance), then a config hot reload of the plugin (`Plugin replacement applied`) ran, then the Gateway stopped. Each instance evaluated once and was disposed exactly once (`count=1`), and no capture directories remained. **Tests:** - New regression `adopts scheduled remote catalogs inside the live Gateway registry scope` fails without the production change (Expected the Gateway registry, received `undefined`) and passes with it. - `server-startup-update-check.test.ts`: 7 passed. `update-startup-request-adoption.test.ts`: 3 passed. oxlint on the changed files passes. `codex review`: clean. No overlap with Pash/Sarah changes. **Merge risk:** two-way door. The change touches no persisted state, config or published contract, and a revert restores the scheduler's unscoped adoption. The blast radius is Gateways with external plugins when a hosted model catalog is adopted. Those catalog rebuilds now borrow Gateway instances under the accepted #161267 behavior. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi

items.summary: perf(agents): preserve image replay prefixes between cleanup batches (#167613) Advance historical image cleanup eight completed turns at a time after the initial cut, preserving recent turns and deterministic restart replay. The live synthetic replay raises cache-read share from 47.35% to 88.66% and reduces cache-read drops from 25 to 4. Retained image context is bounded to 3-10 completed turns; compaction and overflow recovery still own capacity. Regression, 206 sibling files / 2621 tests, and independent review pass. Changed checks pass except four dead exports reproduced on clean main.
